description: This file defines a Java service class for importing and exporting Client objects to and from CSV files, using OpenCSV library for CSV processing. It includes methods for reading clients from a CSV with header, converting them into entities, and saving them, as well as writing a list of client entities back into a CSV file.

classes.name: CsvImportExportService
classes.description: A Spring Service class responsible for importing Client data from CSV files into the system and exporting Client data from the system into CSV files, utilizing OpenCSV for parsing and writing CSV data.

methods.name: readCsvWithHeader
methods.description: Reads a CSV file with headers, parses each row into ClientDto objects, converts them into Client entities, saves them via clientService, and returns the list of Client entities.

methods.name: writeCsv
methods.description: Exports a list of Client entities into a CSV file, converting entities to DTOs and writing them out using OpenCSV.
